intro: Nori Pridedrift is an enterprising dwarf peddling his piping-hot Scalding Mornbrew throughout snowy Coldridge Valley. He makes his living braving the cold to supply shivering mountaineers with their morning pick-me-up, often enlisting swift recruits to run deliveries while the drink remains steaming.

sections.t: A Steaming Cup in the Snow
p: Life in Coldridge Valley is harsh and bitterly cold, and nothing cuts through the chill quite like a draught of Scalding Mornbrew. Nori Pridedrift has carved out a living by brewing and distributing this hot, coffee-like morning drink across the frozen drifts. Because the brew must be consumed while still scalding to be fully appreciated, delivery is a race against the elements. Nori frequently recruits brisk couriers to sprint fresh draughts out to freezing sentries before the mountain air robs the brew of its heat. Just as important as the brew itself are his limited supplies of sturdy mugs, which he expects his runners to return promptly.
